incidents.summary: A union threatened a campaign against Ocado over alleged below-minimum-wage payments to subcontracted Ocado Zoom drivers, which Ocado and its delivery partner denied.

sources.title: Union threatens to ‘stain’ Ocado reputation over wage row
sources.quote: A trade union has threatened a “loud, relentless and effective” campaign against Ocado after claims that the retailer’s drivers have been paid below minimum wage.

sources.title: Union threatens to ‘stain’ Ocado reputation over wage row
sources.quote: Payslips show he was paid around £5 an hour in the first week of August, and £2.91 an hour in the last week of July.

sources.title: Union threatens to ‘stain’ Ocado reputation over wage row
sources.quote: Both Ocado and Ryde deny that drivers were paid below the legal minimum.

positives: Ocado Retail reported paying Climeworks to remove 1,000 tonnes of atmospheric carbon dioxide.
Ocado eliminated PVC, polystyrene and black plastics from its own-label packaging.
Ocado Retail launched a reusable-packaging pilot designed for online grocery shopping.
